# Shaman: the balance ledger (generated by `tools/src/ledger/write.ts shaman`; do not edit by hand)

Hand prices from `tools/src/ledger/shaman.ts`, against the budgets of docs/14_CARD_COSTING.md (1 Mana common = 10, then +9 a Mana; uncommon x1.12, rare x1.25, basic x0.8; an Aura over four turns at 1.5x (uncommon) or 2x (rare) its cost's budget; Consume +25%).
